A model that says \"0.97\" should be rig.zh: 一个给出 “0.97” 的模型，应当在 97% 的情况下是正确的。但多数模型并非如此。可靠性图精确告诉你偏离了多少；ECE 将其概括为一个数；温度缩放则将其压平 — 仅需一个标量参数，无需重新训练。
A model that says \"0.97\" should be rig.src:
A model that says "0.97" should be right 97% of the time.
          Most aren't. The reliability diagram tells you exactly how
          off you are; ECE summarises it; temperature scaling
          collapses it — one scalar parameter, no retraining.

@@T0@@~15 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@UQ.zh:
@@T0@@约 15 分钟@@T1@@
          @@T2@@不确定性量化 · 校准 · 可靠性@@T3@@

A classifier is calibrated if, among all.zh: 若在所有被预测为置信度 $p$ 的样本中，实际正确的比例恰为 $p$，则称该分类器是校准的。对一切 $p$ 皆然，始终如此。现代神经网络以过度自信而闻名：对某个留出的测试点，softmax 给出 0.97，其实际正确比例更可能是约 85% 而非 97%（Guo 等，2017）。
A classifier is calibrated if, among all.src:
A classifier is calibrated if, among all examples where it
          predicts confidence $p$, the fraction that are actually
          correct is $p$. Across $p$. Always. Modern neural networks
          are notoriously over-confident: a softmax of 0.97 on a
          held-out test point is more likely to be right ~85% of the
          time than 97% (Guo et al., 2017).

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n Accur.zh:
@@T0@@一句话概括。@@T1@@
          准确率与校准度彼此独立。一个模型可以准确率高达 90% 却校准得很差；也可以准确率仅 60% 却校准得完美。任何与安全相关的部署都同时关注这两者。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n Accur.src: The slogan. Accuracy and calibration are independent. A model can be 90% accurate and badly miscalibrated; a model can be 60% accurate and perfectly calibrated. Any safety-relevant deployment cares about both.

Bin predictions by their confidence. For.zh: 按置信度将预测分箱。对每个箱，绘制（平均预测置信度）对（经验准确率）。对已校准的分类器，这些点落在对角线上。位于对角线上方：置信不足；位于下方：过度自信。
Bin predictions by their confidence. For.src:
Bin predictions by their confidence. For each bin, plot
          (mean predicted confidence) vs (empirical accuracy). On a
          calibrated classifier this lies on the diagonal. Above the
          diagonal: under-confident. Below: over-confident.

@@T0@@ECE@@T1@@ (expected calibration er.zh:
@@T0@@ECE@@T1@@（期望校准误差）是 $|\text{bin acc} - \text{bin
          confidence}|$ 的加权平均。@@T2@@MCE@@T3@@（最大校准误差）则是最差的箱。@@T4@@Brier 分数@@T5@@ 与 @@T6@@NLL@@T7@@ 是将校准与锐化结合起来的评分规则。
@@T0@@ECE@@T1@@ (expected calibration er.src: ECE (expected calibration error) is the weighted average of $|\text{bin acc} - \text{bin confidence}|$. MCE (max calibration error) is the worst bin. Brier and NLL are scoring rules that combine calibration and refinement.

Train a classifier and watch it miscalib.zh: 训练一个分类器，观察其如何失准
Train a classifier and watch it miscalib.src: Train a classifier and watch it miscalibrate

A 3-class RBF logistic regression on a 2.zh: 在二维数据集上训练一个三分类 RBF 逻辑回归；我们刻意训练越过校准的最佳点，将其推入现代深度网络常有的一味过度自信的状态。
A 3-class RBF logistic regression on a 2.src:
A 3-class RBF logistic regression on a 2-D dataset; we
          train past the calibration sweet spot to deliberately push
          it into the over-confident regime modern deep nets tend to
          inhabit.

@@T0@@step @@T1@@0@@T2@@@@T3@@\n.src: step 0 accuracy — ECE —

Decision boundary on test data.zh: 测试数据上的决策边界

@@T0@@What to watch for.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@观察要点。@@T1@@
          在前约 50 步中，准确率与 ECE 同时改善。越过约 150 步后，准确率趋于平台，但各箱开始偏离对角线向下漂移 — 模型变得过度自信了。将 T 从 1 滑向约 2，观察各箱上移至对角线，而准确率完全保持不变。这就是温度缩放。
@@T0@@What to watch for.@@T1@@\n.src: What to watch for. For the first ~50 steps accuracy and ECE both improve. Past ~150 steps, accuracy plateaus but the bins drift below the diagonal — the model has become over-confident. Slide T from 1 toward ~2 and watch the bins migrate up to the diagonal while accuracy stays exactly the same. That's temperature scaling.

Temperature scaling — one parameter, big.zh: 温度缩放 —— 一个参数，收效显著
Temperature scaling — one parameter, big.src: Temperature scaling — one parameter, big win

Replace the softmax $p_c = e^{z_c} / \\s.zh: 在推断时将 softmax $p_c = e^{z_c} / \sum e^{z_{c'}}$ 替换为 $p_c^{(T)} = e^{z_c / T} / \sum e^{z_{c'} / T}$。在留出的验证集上通过最小化 NLL 来拟合 $T$。对过度自信的网络，$T$ 通常取 $\in [1, 3]$；你无需触碰权重即可恢复大部分校准度。
Replace the softmax $p_c = e^{z_c} / \\s.src:
Replace the softmax $p_c = e^{z_c} / \sum e^{z_{c'}}$ with
          $p_c^{(T)} = e^{z_c / T} / \sum e^{z_{c'} / T}$ at inference.
          Fit $T$ on a held-out validation set by minimising NLL.
          Tipically $T \in [1, 3]$ for over-confident networks; you
          recover most of the calibration without touching the
          weights.

Other recipes when temperature alone isn.zh: 当仅靠温度不足以解决问题时，还有其他方案：@@T0@@Platt 缩放@@T1@@（在 logit 上做逻辑回归，适用于二分类）、@@T2@@等渗回归@@T3@@（非参数单调拟合）、@@T4@@直方图分箱@@T5@@、@@T6@@向量 / 矩阵缩放@@T7@@（逐类温度）。选择其中最简单而有效者。
Other recipes when temperature alone isn.src: Other recipes when temperature alone isn't enough: Platt scaling (logistic regression on logits, binary), isotonic regression (non-parametric monotone fit), histogram binning, vector / matrix scaling (per-class temperatures). Pick the simplest that works.

Four post-hoc calibrators, side by side.zh: 四种事后校准器，并排比较
Four post-hoc calibrators, side by side.src: Four post-hoc calibrators, side by side

Temperature scaling is a one-parameter f.zh: 温度缩放是一个单参数的修正手段。但有时一个参数并不够。以下是实践中会遇到的四种事后校准器，它们在同一留出验证集上拟合，随后在同一测试集上评估：
Temperature scaling is a one-parameter f.src:
Temperature scaling is a one-parameter fix. Sometimes one
          parameter isn't enough. Here are the four post-hoc
          calibrators you'll meet in practice, fit on the same
          held-out validation set and then evaluated on the same test
          set:

@@T0@@Temperature scaling.@@T1@@ One sca.zh: @@T0@@温度缩放。@@T1@@ 一个标量 $T$。开销低廉，保持准确率。最常用的默认选择。
@@T0@@Temperature scaling.@@T1@@ One sca.src: Temperature scaling. One scalar $T$. Cheap, accuracy-preserving. Most popular default.

@@T0@@Platt scaling.@@T1@@ Logistic regr.zh: @@T0@@Platt 缩放。@@T1@@ 对最大 logit 作逻辑回归：$p = \sigma(a\,z_{\max} + b)$。两个参数。二分类问题上的强基线。
@@T0@@Platt scaling.@@T1@@ Logistic regr.src: Platt scaling. Logistic regression on the max logit: $p = \sigma(a\,z_{\max} + b)$. Two parameters. Strong baseline for binary problems.

@@T0@@Isotonic regression.@@T1@@ Non-par.zh: @@T0@@等渗回归。@@T1@@ 在分箱可靠性曲线上作非参数单调拟合。参数较多，但能在不扭曲排序的前提下可靠地完成校准。
@@T0@@Isotonic regression.@@T1@@ Non-par.src: Isotonic regression. Non-parametric monotone fit on the binned reliability curve. Many parameters, but reliably calibrates without distorting the ordering.

@@T0@@Vector scaling.@@T1@@ Per-class te.zh: @@T0@@向量缩放。@@T1@@ 在 softmax 之前对 logit 施加逐类温度 $T_c$。共 $C$ 个参数；当过度自信程度依赖类别时尤为有用。
@@T0@@Vector scaling.@@T1@@ Per-class te.src: Vector scaling. Per-class temperatures $T_c$ on logits before softmax. $C$ parameters; useful when over-confidence is class-dependent.

Reliability diagrams for the four post-h.zh: 同一个已训练分类器上四种事后校准器的可靠性图。每个面板下方给出 ECE。
Reliability diagrams for the four post-h.src: Reliability diagrams for the four post-hoc calibrators on the same trained classifier. ECE shown under each panel.

@@T0@@The verdict.@@T1@@ Temperature sca.zh: @@T0@@结论。@@T1@@ 温度缩放在准确率 + 简洁性 + 参数数量上几乎总是胜出。等渗回归与向量缩放在严重失准的多分类问题上可能略胜一筹，但需要更多参数。Platt 缩放仅适用于二分类，且在很大程度上已被温度缩放所涵盖。
@@T0@@The verdict.@@T1@@ Temperature sca.src: The verdict. Temperature scaling almost always wins on accuracy + simplicity + parameter count. Isotonic and vector scaling can edge ahead on severely-miscalibrated multi-class problems but cost more parameters. Platt is binary-only and largely subsumed by temperature.

@@T0@@Deployed alerting.@@T1@@ A \"high-.zh: @@T0@@已部署的告警系统。@@T1@@ 一个带有 0.95 校准置信度的“高风险”告警是可据以行动的；而相同数值若出自一个过度自信的模型，则只是噪声。
@@T0@@Deployed alerting.@@T1@@ A \"high-.src: Deployed alerting. A "high-risk" alert with 0.95 calibrated confidence is actionable; the same number from an over-confident model is just noise.

@@T0@@Medical / safety-critical decision.zh: @@T0@@医疗 / 安全攸关的决策。@@T1@@ 其输出用于支撑治疗方案或运行决策的模型@@T2@@必须@@T3@@ 交付经过校准的概率 —— 否则下游决策便建立在错误的依据之上。
@@T0@@Medical / safety-critical decision.src: Medical / safety-critical decisions. A model whose outputs feed treatment or operational choices must ship calibrated probabilities — otherwise downstream decisions are made on the wrong basis.

@@T0@@Active learning + Bayes-Opt.@@T1@@.zh:
@@T0@@主动学习 + 贝叶斯优化。@@T1@@
            采集函数（BALD、EI）读取置信度；校准一旦失效，每一个考虑不确定性的下游选择都会随之失效。
@@T0@@Active learning + Bayes-Opt.@@T1@@.src: Active learning + Bayes-Opt. Acquisition functions (BALD, EI) read confidence; broken calibration breaks every uncertainty-aware downstream choice.

@@T0@@Conformal sandwich.@@T1@@ Conforma.zh:
@@T0@@保形三明治。@@T1@@ 保形预测（参见
            @@T2@@保形一文@@T3@@）
            能给出覆盖率保证，但当基模型校准良好时间隔会更紧。先校准，后保形。
@@T0@@Conformal sandwich.@@T1@@ Conforma.src: Conformal sandwich. Conformal prediction (the conformal article) gives a coverage guarantee but tighter intervals when the base model is well-calibrated. Calibrate first, conformal second.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n E.zh:
@@T0@@最终要点。@@T1@@
          每一个已部署的模型都应当随附一张可靠性图和一个 ECE 数值。这不过是 30 行代码，却能告诉你这些置信度究竟有没有意义。若没有意义，温度缩放就是最廉价的修补手段。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n E.src: Final takeaway. Every deployed model should ship with a reliability plot and an ECE number. It's 30 lines of code and it tells you whether the confidences mean anything. Temperature scaling is the cheapest possible repair if they don't.

Why neural nets miscalibrate in the firs.zh: 神经网络为何从一开始就会失准
Why neural nets miscalibrate in the firs.src: Why neural nets miscalibrate in the first place

Guo et&nbsp;al. (2017) traced modern ove.zh: Guo 等（2017）将现代的过度自信追溯到三个原因：
Guo et&nbsp;al. (2017) traced modern ove.src: Guo et al. (2017) traced modern over-confidence to three things:

@@T0@@Capacity.@@T1@@ Bigger models can.zh: @@T0@@容量。@@T1@@ 更大的模型可以通过把 logit 推向 $\pm \infty$ 而将训练 NLL 压至零。这以最强自信的 softmax 完美拟合训练集；留出分布却滞后。测试时的置信度最终系统性地偏高。
@@T0@@Capacity.@@T1@@ Bigger models can.src: Capacity. Bigger models can drive training NLL to zero by pushing logits to $\pm \infty$. That fits the training set perfectly with maximally-confident softmaxes; the held-out distribution lags. Test confidence ends up systematically too high.

@@T0@@Weight decay reduction.@@T1@@ Mode.zh: @@T0@@权重衰减的减少。@@T1@@ 现代训练所用的权重衰减远少于早先的模型；缺少这一隐式正则化器，logit 便会漂移得更大。
@@T0@@Weight decay reduction.@@T1@@ Mode.src: Weight decay reduction. Modern training uses much less weight decay than older models; without that implicit regulariser, logits drift larger.

@@T0@@BatchNorm.@@T1@@ Empirically corre.zh: @@T0@@BatchNorm。@@T1@@ 经验上它与更差的校准相关联，可能是因为逐批统计量给 logit 引入了随机性，而模型通过平均意义上过度押注来加以补偿。
@@T0@@BatchNorm.@@T1@@ Empirically corre.src: BatchNorm. Empirically correlated with worse calibration, possibly because per-batch statistics introduce stochasticity in logits that the model compensates by overcommitting on average.

The good news: temperature scaling fixes.zh: 好消息是：在独立同分布的测试集上，温度缩放能修正上述几乎所有问题。坏消息是：@@T0@@在分布偏移之下，仅靠温度缩放已不再足够@@T1@@ —— 在分布内验证集上得到的最优 $T$ 对发生偏移的测试分布是错误的。Ovadia 等（2019）以实验证明了这一点。缓解手段包括：使用 mixup / 标签平滑训练（内禀校准），或采用保形预测（它在可交换性假设下具有覆盖率保证，而该假设仍会被偏移所破坏，只是破坏程度不那么灾难性）。
The good news: temperature scaling fixes.src: The good news: temperature scaling fixes essentially all of this on i.i.d. test sets. The bad news: under distribution shift, temperature scaling alone is no longer enough — the optimal $T$ on the in-distribution validation set is wrong for the shifted test distribution. Ovadia et al. (2019) showed this empirically. Mitigations: train with mixup / label smoothing (intrinsic calibration), or use conformal prediction (which has a coverage guarantee under exchangeability assumptions that are still violated by shift, but less catastrophically).

Beyond classification — regression calib.zh: 超越分类 —— 回归的校准

For regression, \"calibrated\" means: a.zh: 对回归而言，“已校准”意味着：90% 的预测区间应当在 90% 的情况下覆盖真实值。可靠性图此时被覆盖率对名义水平的图所取代：
For regression, \"calibrated\" means: a.src: For regression, "calibrated" means: a 90% predictive interval should cover the true value 90% of the time. The reliability diagram is replaced by a coverage-vs-nominal plot:

The expected calibration error for regre.zh: 回归的期望校准误差为 $\int_0^1 |\mathrm{coverage}(\alpha) - \alpha|\, d\alpha$。修正回归失准的工具包括：
The expected calibration error for regre.src: The expected calibration error for regression is $\int_0^1 |\mathrm{coverage}(\alpha) - \alpha|\, d\alpha$. Tools to fix regression miscalibration:

@@T0@@Quantile regression with pinball l.zh: @@T0@@使用 pinball 损失的分位数回归@@T1@@ 无需分布假设即可直接学习条件分位数。
@@T0@@Quantile regression with pinball l.src: Quantile regression with pinball loss directly learns conditional quantiles without distributional assumptions.

@@T0@@Conformalised quantile regression.zh: @@T0@@保形化分位数回归（CQR）@@T1@@ 将分位数模型包裹进保形预测，以获得无需分布假设的覆盖率保证。
@@T0@@Conformalised quantile regression.src: Conformalised quantile regression (CQR) wraps the quantile model in conformal prediction for a distribution-free coverage guarantee.

@@T0@@Isotonic regression on the CDF.@@T.zh: @@T0@@对 CDF 作等渗回归。@@T1@@ 拟合一个单调变换 $\hat F(y|x) \mapsto F(y|x)$，将模型的 CDF 映射到经验 CDF。
@@T0@@Isotonic regression on the CDF.@@T.src: Isotonic regression on the CDF. Fit a monotone transformation $\hat F(y|x) \mapsto F(y|x)$ that maps the model's CDF to the empirical one.

@@T0@@Guo, Pleiss, Sun, Weinberger (2017.zh: @@T0@@Guo、Pleiss、Sun、Weinberger（2017）@@T1@@ — @@T2@@On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks.@@T3@@ 定义了 ECE；提出了温度缩放。
@@T0@@Guo, Pleiss, Sun, Weinberger (2017.src: Guo, Pleiss, Sun, Weinberger (2017) — On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks. Defined ECE; introduced temperature scaling.

@@T0@@Platt (1999)@@T1@@ &mdash; @@T2@@P.zh: @@T0@@Platt（1999）@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Probabilistic outputs for SVMs.@@T3@@ Platt 缩放。

@@T0@@Zadrozny &amp; Elkan (2002)@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@Zadrozny & Elkan（2002）@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Transforming Classifier Scores into Accurate Multiclass Probability Estimates.@@T3@@ 等渗回归。
@@T0@@Zadrozny &amp; Elkan (2002)@@T1@@.src: Zadrozny & Elkan (2002) — Transforming Classifier Scores into Accurate Multiclass Probability Estimates. Isotonic.

@@T0@@Ovadia et&nbsp;al. (2019)@@T1@@ &m.zh: @@T0@@Ovadia 等（2019）@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Can You Trust Your Model's Uncertainty?@@T3@@ 关于分布外校准的论文。
@@T0@@Ovadia et&nbsp;al. (2019)@@T1@@ &m.src: Ovadia et al. (2019) — Can You Trust Your Model's Uncertainty? The OOD calibration paper.

@@T0@@Kuleshov, Fenner, Ermon (2018)@@T1.zh: @@T0@@Kuleshov、Fenner、Ermon（2018）@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Accurate Uncertainties for Deep Learning Using Calibrated Regression.@@T3@@
@@T0@@Kuleshov, Fenner, Ermon (2018)@@T1.src: Kuleshov, Fenner, Ermon (2018) — Accurate Uncertainties for Deep Learning Using Calibrated Regression.

@@T0@@Niculescu-Mizil &amp; Caruana (200.zh: @@T0@@Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana（2005）@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Predicting Good Probabilities With Supervised Learning.@@T3@@ 经典的各种校准器对比论文。
@@T0@@Niculescu-Mizil &amp; Caruana (200.src: Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana (2005) — Predicting Good Probabilities With Supervised Learning. The classical calibrator-comparison paper.

meta.title: 校准与可靠性图
meta.tagline: 为何 softmax 的 0.97 并不意味着 97% —— 以及那个常能将其治愈的单参数修正
meta.summary: 实时训练一个小型分类器；绘制可靠性图（分箱后的预测置信度对经验准确率）；并排比较 ECE、MCE、Brier 与 NLL。滑动温度缩放参数，观察校准误差如何在不改变准确率的情况下坍缩。本讲的要点是：任何已部署的可持续性模型都应随附一张可靠性图。
highlights: 实时训练一个三分类 RBF 逻辑回归分类器；可靠性图在每一步后更新。
ECE / MCE / Brier / NLL 柱条并排展示，使你看到哪个指标对什么作出响应。
温度缩放滑块能在不触碰准确率的前提下压平 ECE —— 深度学习中最廉价的不确定性量化升级。
与实验对齐：已部署的传感器 / 空气质量 / 健康模型都应随附一张可靠性图。

NLL/log_e.zh: NLL（nats，以 e 为底的对数）

Train past step ~50 to populate four cal.zh: 训练超过约第 50 步以填充四种校准器。
